answer: LIST st, ci, z, sta FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO (g / t) AS e AND ALSO has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity ci AND ALSO has SchoolZip z AND ALSO has SchoolState sta WHERE t > 0 ORDERED WITH e ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolLongitude lo AND ALSO has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO abs(lo) AS a ORDERED WITH a DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, d FROM Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType d AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a AND ALSO (k - a) AS diff WHERE diff > THE AVERAGE diff2 IN (Frpm [has FrpmCharterFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS diff2)
LIST n FROM School has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 f AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE f / k > 0.1 AND g > 0
LIST c, cnt FROM School e [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY c AS cnt WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH cnt DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
